useCase: クローン領域、テクスチャの複製、オブジェクト除去の隠蔽の検出
mechanism: 抽出します local 特徴 descriptors using SIFT or SURF algorithms, then performs nearest-neighbor matching を識別するために duplicate regions. RANSAC filters geometric 不整合 to confirm true copy-move forgeries.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 80-90% for copy-move forgeries with minimal post-processing
name: コピー・ムーブ検出
parameters: Feature detector: SIFT, Match 閾値: 0.75 (Lowe's ratio), Min matches: 10, RANSAC reproj 閾値: 5.0
description: 検出します duplicated regions 内の an image using keypoint matching. AI tools sometimes replicate texture patches, creating detectable copy-move パターン.

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2011). A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection. IEEE TIFS.
Christlein, V. et al. (2012). An Evaluation of Popular Copy-Move Forgery Detection Approaches. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Excellent for detecting cloned regions
• RANSAC filtering reduces 誤検出
• Can detect scaled/rotated copies
• Well-proven フォレンジック technique
limitations:
• Only 検出する duplication 内の single image
• Heavy post-processing can mask copied regions
• 計算コストが高い for large images
• May miss very small duplicated areas
